feeds.title: Natalie MacLean Blog
feeds.description: Canada's best wine courses, tasting classes, food pairings, and expert reviews of LCBO, SAQ, BCLDB wines by Natalie MacLean, named the World's Best Drinks Writer. Natalie will help you find the right wine every time!

feeds.title: John Schreiner on wine
feeds.description: John Schreiner is Canada's most prolific writer of books on wine. Since his first book in 1984, The World of Canadian Wine, he has written 15, including multiple editions of The Wineries of British Columba, British Columbia Wine Country, and John Schreiner's Okanagan Wine Tour Guide.

feeds.title: Tony Aspler, the Wine Guy
feeds.description: Tony Aspler is an internationally known writer, speaker, and wine expert, based in Toronto, Canada. He has been writing about wine for over 40 years.

feeds.title: Wines In Niagara
feeds.description: Wines In Niagara is a website that focuses primarily on the wonderful wines and food made in the Niagara Peninsula. The mission is to be as complete, current, interactive and informative as we possibly can be.

feeds.title: Canadian Wine Guy
feeds.description: CanadianWineGuy (CWG) is a simple idea hatched from an even simpler individual. Someone asked CWG why he did not document and pass on the information he was so ready to share, CWG thought that maybe this internet thing may be the best way to do it and thus this blog was thought of.

feeds.title: Vintages Wine Picks & Reviews
feeds.description: Bi-weekly LCBO wine picks from VINTAGES magazine and wine reviews. Focusing on high quality red wine, white wine, rose wine, Port wine, dessert wine, and Icewine that you can afford.

feeds.title: Pro Tips & Wine Bargains in B.C.
feeds.description: Are you a wine drinker in B.C. who is tired of the same wine choices? Would you like to try something different, but feel overwhelmed by the parade of labels at your local wine store? Let me help you find that 'really good' bottle of wine in the same price range to enjoy and share with friends. Having been in and around wine, including professionally, in British Columbia for 45 years, I have given wine suggestions and practical wine tips to my family, friends and guests such as 'Buy this wine, it's great value' 'OK, here's the deal on decanting' or 'a really good wine to go with roast chick..

feeds.title: BC Pinot Noir
feeds.description: The BC Pinot Noir blog provide information about the wineries, vineyards, and winemakers crafting pinot noir wines in British Columbia, Canada. It provides insights into the region's winemaking industry, wine reviews, and stories about producers, focusing on the diversity and quality of local Pinot Noir. Aimed at wine enthusiasts and connoisseurs, it combines expert knowledge with engaging narratives to celebrate this celebrated varietal.

feeds.title: MyWinePal
feeds.description: KArl covers BC wines as well as travel to BC wine regions. Beyond wine reviews, he travels to wine regions for more knowledge, and loves to pair food with wine and give his recommendations.

feeds.title: Okanagan Crush Pad Blog
feeds.description: Our Haywire, Narrative, Free Form and Bizou +Yukon wines celebrate the unique microclimates of Okanagan Valley terroir. Our organic farming principles follow us into the cellar, where we let nature shape and direct each wine we make.

feeds.title: uncorkBC Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Kayla and my goal is to explore the best of Wine and Food from across our beautiful province, British Columbia. uncorkBC celebrates the stories behind the labels and shares information on events and new releases you don't want to miss.Join me as I uncork the best of BC Wine and travel across the province to experience our incredible wine country!

feeds.title: Crowfoot Wine & Spirits » Wine
feeds.description: Crowfoot Wine & Spirits offers an unparalleled selection of wine, spirits and beer, with friendly and knowledgeable staff. A family owned and operated liquor business since 1994 with 9 locations in the Calgary area.

feeds.title: Terry Pomerantz's Wine Blog
feeds.description: Terry Pomerantz is a philanthropist and wine enthusiast from Montreal, Canada. Come explore and broaden your knowledge of wine with his advice and reviews!

feeds.title: BC Wine Lover
feeds.description: BC Wine Lover is about sharing our personal stories and experiences and those from our wine friends too. We champion the high standards of our indigenous wine & grape growing industry while raising a glass to their success.

feeds.title: AdVINEtures Blog
feeds.description: We are Allison & Chris Wallace, avid lovers of both travel and wine. AdVINEtures will share the stories of our travels and the wines we enjoy along the way. In this blog, we hope to bring alive the excitement we feel when visiting fascinating places by telling our stories and showing photos and videos.

feeds.title: La Route des vins Blog
feeds.description: Tips and stories to inspire your next visit to the wine region of Quebec.

feeds.title: BC Wine Trends
feeds.description: Your Source for the Best Value BC Wine. Published over 350 articles on BC Wineries, Wine Industry Trends, and Wine Economics.

feeds.title: Joanie's Wine Blog
feeds.description: Joanie's wine blog aims to share wine tales and adventures by sharing experience and knowledge. Joanie is the most influential wine writers in Canada.

feeds.title: Wander Food and Wine Blog
feeds.description: Wander Food & Wine is a chic restaurant and lounge to learn about other cultures through food and wine and classes. Specializing in small plates, an eclectic wine list, and wine classes, Wander will become your favourite escape.

feeds.title: VineRoutes
feeds.description: Stories about wine, the people who make it and the places it comes from. VineRoutes is an Ontario, Canada based platform that intends to provide insight not just on Canada's wine regions, but on a variety of regions around the world. And there are so many to celebrate.

feeds.title: pop & pour • wine | spirits | reviews | yyc
feeds.description: An independent Calgary wine blog written by bloggers Peter Vetsch and Raymond Lamontagne focused on wine enjoyment and education one bottle or event at a time.

feeds.title: Wine Tasting Demystified Blog
feeds.description: Every wine tasting experience should bring you unique sensations and satisfaction. Discover how to step up your skills with Wine Tasting Demystified.

feeds.title: Capital Wine Blog
feeds.description: A high-reaching wine consultancy and home delivery service sourcing some of the top wines from around the world and throughout Canada. Based out of Ottawa, servicing all of Eastern Ontario.

feeds.title: My Wine Canada Blog
feeds.description: Writing on Canadian Wine by the MWC team Kurtis Kolt (BC), Ben MacPhee-Sigurdson (MB) Jake Skakun (ON), Michelle Bouffard (QB), and various national guest contributors. Read about everything you need to know in the world of wine. My Wine Canada lets you buy wine online from many Canadian wineries and have it delivered right to your door.
